answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and commit to an epoch polynomial; its evaluations authenticate rate-limit nullifiers in zero-knowledge proofs. Reusing a message slot exposes two shares, which Shamir interpolation combines to recover the registered private key and trigger immediate collateral slashing. The hollow claim of unlimited anonymity fails: a cipher-bound beacon fixes the epoch, and duplicate proofs make Sybil participation costly and detectable.
